6.7.rationale: The excerpts include general non-discrimination language (including ethnicity/religion) but do not explicitly identify minority/isolated/indigenous women as a protected target group or provide measures specifically for such groups.

6.11.rationale: The only mention related to domestic workers is within the definition of “household,” not as a target group for special protection measures. No provisions specifically address domestic workers as beneficiaries of protection/services.

6.13.rationale: None of the cited sentences mention former inmates/correctional institutions or formerly incarcerated women as a group receiving special protection measures.
